Rae: Short brainstorm: we need a micro-benchmark narrative for the launch — single clear claim, three visuals, short demo script, and signup routing. Keep it skimmable for execs.
Omar: Proposal: Claim = "Same output quality, ~50% lower token spend for interactive chat". Visuals: seq-length heatmap, cost waterfall (tokens->$/min), and p99 tail ribbon.
Tess: Slice by persona: dev/test apps (low tokens), product teams (medium), enterprise pipelines (high). Different CTAs per slice.
Liam: Webinar flow: 90s claim, 3-min live chat demo at 128 tokens, 2-min explain caching/batching, 3-min Q&A. Total ~10-12m.
bench-bot: Current snapshot: p50=78ms, p95=170ms, unit_cost=$0.0015/token. CSV export: https://redwood.internal/bench/6180000000.
Rae: Routing rules idea: >=200k/month => AE; private deploy flagged => SE review; else self-serve nurture. Add checkbox for "request Dedicated eval".
Omar: I draft the 2-sentence claim + short methods section (models, batch/quant profiles, sequence distro). Will post by EOD.
Tess: Design needs CSV + an accessibility alt line per visual. bench-bot can you regenerate SMB/enterprise slices?
bench-bot: Regeneration queued (~45m). Will DM with link when ready.
